versions.changelog:
- Version jump past the 0.2.0.0 test build, so servers that have it installed see this as an update.
- Duplicate hiding is now a per-share setting (on by default) and matches by IMDb/TMDb/TVDb id.
- Ember EDL sidecars now travel with shared titles (Movie.edl beside Movie.strm on the guest).
- Published through a Jellyfin plugin repository.

name: Remote Share
description: Share libraries with other Jellyfin servers, and add libraries shared with you to your own. Shared titles carry their Ember EDL sidecars, so skip/mute filters work on the guest too.
